title: Tue 10 Nov 2026: Dow surges over a thousand points, oil slides on Iran hopes, US inflation due today, FCA illiquid fund redemption proposals
summary: Wall Street and Europe rebound sharply as oil falls on hopes of calmer talks with Iran, with Asia rallying again this morning. American inflation lands at half past one UK time, with UK growth on Thursday. In regulation, the FCA's proposals on redemption terms for funds holding illiquid assets, the wider fund rulebook reform and the crypto consultation closing on the eighteenth of November, plus new active ETF launches, three COO action points and the diary for the week.
